name: t1-repeater-transplant
notes: T1 (corrupt-events), watch-only: repeater A (delay 4, FACING=south: input from the south cell, output to the north lamp) is triggered at window 0 (script places the redstone block: an 8 gt tick is pending). At window 3 the script breaks A and places repeater B rotated (FACING=west: input from the empty west cell, output to the east lamp, delay 1). DiodeBlock.tick turns an OFF repeater ON unconditionally, so at the pending tick B must pulse into the EAST lamp for its own 2 gt despite never having an input, and the north lamp must never light. Watch: mctas bedrock watch <this> --to 14 --verbose --cells 0,1,-1 --cells 1,1,0 --cells 0,1,1. The target/chord are dummies for the watch focus cell (the chord never runs under watch).
